column1: # Postgres 16's built-in operators (pg_catalog's pg_operator), one a line: oid, name, left and right operand type oids
# (0 for a prefix operator's left) and those types as format_type names them (NONE for none). What regoper and
# regoperator read and show; made from a real Postgres 16 with
#   select oid, oprname, oprleft, oprright, format_type(oprleft), format_type(oprright) from pg_operator
# Then what the planner reads of each (see `opt`): oprrest and oprjoin (their functions' names, - for none),
# oprcanhash and oprcanmerge (t or f), and the oids of oprcode, oprnegate and oprcom (0 for none). Those are from
# src/include/catalog/pg_operator.dat (16.14), joined on oid, with oprcode's oid from pg_proc.dat; they equal
#   select oid, oprrest, oprjoin, oprcanhash, oprcanmerge, oprcode::oid, oprnegate, oprcom from pg_operator
